title: Chapter 1444
text:
Han Xiao learned the details from the three leaders, so he did not continue to participate in their brainstorming. He deactivated the remote projection and went to the frontline research institute.

As soon as he walked into the experiment hall filled with instruments, he could smell the anxiety and panic in the air. Countless researchers were coming and going, sweating profusely as they deciphered the encoded particles.

"Your Excellency Black Star, Ruler Marbruce has given me a secret order. Please follow me."

An officer who had been waiting for a long time immediately came up and led Han Xiao into the corridor.

Not long after, the two of them arrived at a private laboratory. There was a team of experts working on the deciphering as well. However, unlike the deciphering of the content of the encoded particles outside, this place was also responsible for looking for the technical characteristics of the encoded particles. As soon as the door opened, Han Xiao could hear endless arguments inside.

"… The structural deviation of this particle is obviously too high, forming a typical three-branch ratio with Marvel's reading. It has the characteristics of Kapok warping technology and Siber space conversion. It's definitely an application based on the third theoretical model of particle space science!"

"It's just similar! You ignored the characteristics of dimensional conversion and the weakening of the nuclear force. This is obviously a technology that has been eliminated by the three Universal Civilizations! "

Han Xiao turned around and saw the experts gathered in front of the experiment table, pointing at the readings on the instrument and arguing.

The same theory could be extended to all kinds of applications. It was just that although some technologies were similar in terms of appearance and final results, there were many differences in the actual process of use. In a less accurate but simpler way, it was probably equivalent to the difference in the order of strokes and the font of calligraphy. For example, there were four ways to write the characters, so there was naturally more than one way to modify the particles …

By studying the characteristics of these technologies, they could reverse engineer the specific technology used by the encoded particles. This was also the focus of their research at this time, trying to narrow down the scope of suspicion through the technology used by the encoded particles.

Han Xiao did not hide his footsteps and walked over. Only then did the experts realize that there was an outsider. Seeing that it was Han Xiao, they all lowered their heads and bowed respectfully.

He looked up at the encoded particles floating on the experiment table and waved his hands.

"Alright, stop arguing. Let me see what's going on."

"If you need anything, please tell us."

The group of experts did not object and retreated to the side, obediently giving up the experiment table behind them.

Black Star was not only the most powerful individual in the galaxy who was on equal footing with the three leaders, but he was also one of the most powerful scientists. These researchers had always admired Black Star, and almost half of the people present were his admirers. They were usually respected senior researchers, but now they were willing to be his assistants.

Han Xiao glanced at the reading and studied the coded particles from the beginning. He quickly analyzed the data in his mind and quickly locked onto a few technologies. His expression changed slightly.

As far as he knew, these technologies seemed to be used by the members of the Supercluster Alliance. Of course, he could not rule out the possibility of other organizations imitating them.

"According to normal judgment, the Supercluster Alliance is even more suspicious, but it could also be a deliberate framing … If that's the case, it's more like a traitor within the galactic society."

With a thought, Han Xiao released his Mechanical Force, connected to the coded particles, and activated (Bold Explorer).

Buzz!

Han Xiao's vision suddenly changed, and he arrived at a research institute with a different style. Many researchers were operating.

A huge device was buzzing, and particles were being unfolded in low dimensions one after another. Information was recorded, and then they were restored, turning into coded particles that were injected into three white cylindrical containers.

He could not control his vision and followed the three white tubes closely. The white tubes were placed into a suitcase and sent into the groove of a material transfer device.

The next moment, his vision turned again, and he had already arrived at a secret underground base. He saw another material transfer device, and with a flash of light, the white suitcase was transferred over. A few lifeforms walked forward and opened it, revealing the white tubes inside.

At this time, his vision changed again, and he came to a cosmic space. A blue and black wormhole opened in front of him, and then three white round tubes were thrown in. They passed through the colorful space tunnel and flew out from the other end of the wormhole. Then, the three white round tubes suddenly bloomed with hot light and self-detonated, releasing a wave of energy. The encoded particles inside were all thrown out.

In the last scene, a World Tree exploration team wrapped in green light appeared in the distance.

The illusion stopped abruptly, and Han Xiao's vision returned to normal.

"Looks like these coded particles came from nothing until they were intercepted by the World Tree …"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. Chapter 510 Literature

Although the illusion provided by (Bold Explorer) did not involve a specific location, Han Xiao was basically certain that a third party was behind this. There was no other reason. It was simply because the researchers he caught a glimpse of in the illusion were all unfamiliar species. And among the people who received the white suitcase, there was a species that should have disappeared in history long ago.

"The Lorax people, the intelligent species of the Lorax Civilization … The Lorax Civilization, the loser of the exploration era, was destroyed by the three Universal Civilizations. It should have been destroyed …"

Han Xiao flipped through the information and pondered. All kinds of possibilities appeared in his mind.

From the looks of it, the Lorax civilization had survived, and their goal should be revenge. They were not fighting alone and had even found helpers. Those intelligent species had never appeared in the history of the three Universal Civilizations, so they should be foreign civilizations.

According to the details of the information in the coded particles, this foreign civilization should have been lurking in the explored universe for many years without being discovered.

"Tsk, another old enemy from the exploration era. The three Universal Civilizations are constantly paying back their debts for their past deeds …"

Han Xiao subconsciously rubbed his fingers.

In his previous life, during the World Tree War, this foreign civilization did not appear and did not seem to have interfered with the direction of the war. Now, they took the initiative to backstab the three Universal Civilizations. Perhaps it was because this foreign civilization was in a different situation in different timelines, or perhaps it was because the situation in his previous life did not require their intervention. Of course, Han Xiao was not sure if this foreign civilization had taken action in his previous life. The players did not have the relevant information.

"Seeing that the three Universal Civilizations have the advantage, they want to destroy our strategy, destroy our advantage, and help the World Tree invade us … They want to take revenge by borrowing someone else's knife, but they also want to take advantage of the situation. They want to hide in the dark and watch the tigers fight. Tsk, their intentions are sinister."

Han Xiao guessed the motives of the foreign civilization while thinking of a solution.

Although he had confirmed that a third party was behind this, he did not know the other party's location, so he could not follow the clues. If he searched on a large scale, it was very likely that the foreign civilization would withdraw all their spies and completely cut off all clues.

Furthermore, without evidence, it would be difficult to convince the three hooligans. Although with his status, even if there was no evidence, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations would still value his words. However, now that even he was suspected, his credibility would naturally be reduced. The three leaders would at most be skeptical.

(Information Form Obliteration) could see the connection threads, but this was a destructive skill. He could not see the specific situation and did not have the ability to trace it back to the source. Even if he erased this batch of coded particles, there was a high chance that the World Tree still had others, and he would not be able to resolve this situation. After all, this skill erased an 'individual', not an entire 'concept' or 'collective'. It would not happen that if one or two people were killed, the others would forget about the entire human race.

In fact, the effect of (Information Form Obliteration) was very 'precise'. It would not affect the target's other information too much. Therefore, the effect of this move would be more unique when it came to the split parts of a similar whole.

If he used (Information Form Obliteration) on the coded particles in front of him, Han Xiao estimated that the result would be that the three leaders would remember that he had taken some things to study, but they would forget that he was studying the coded particles. Furthermore, the experts present would not remember what they were studying previously, and the readings of these instruments would be erased.

If he 'erased' the other coded particles that the three Universal Civilizations had intercepted, Han Xiao felt that the three Universal Civilizations would probably forget about the existence of the coded particles, but they would remember that 'something' had revealed the secret of the spy leaking the information. On the other hand, the World Tree remembered that they had given the three Universal Civilizations' something ', but they had forgotten to hand over the coded particles. However, they would not forget the coded particles in their hands.

Han Xiao had made a hypothesis. If he used (Information Form Obliteration) to deal with the entire World Tree Civilization, the reaction of the three Universal Civilizations would most likely not be 'what have we been doing all these years' but 'we defeated a Universal Civilization with great difficulty, but we can't remember the name of that civilization'.

Therefore, (Information Form Obliteration) had a very good effect on individuals with information differences (such as living beings). However, when dealing with individuals in batches (such as a grain of sand in a desert, a gun in a batch of standard firearms), the information gap could actually be deduced using logic … For example, if the expert team forgot what they were studying previously, but came to the experiment hall and saw that others were studying the coded particles, they would be able to deduce that they were also studying this thing previously.

However, even if you used logic to deduce it, (Information Form Obliteration) would still be in effect. You would subtly have memory deviations, quick forgetting, subconsciously ignoring, common sense fallacies, and so on. It was like you remembered something, but you suddenly forgot about it in the blink of an eye. No matter how hard you tried, you could not remember it. This kind of situation was not uncommon. It was also like you believing that the temperature of a normal person's bathwater was eighty degrees instead of forty degrees. There would be a common sense deviation that was hard to notice, or the legendary '99 War …

"In any case, I have to think of a way to catch these spies. Currently, I can only use conventional methods to secretly gather information. It's best if there are more surveillance artificial intelligences in the quantum network … They most likely want to continue observing the follow-up effects of this borrowed knife to kill people. Seeing the three Universal Civilizations suffer, they probably didn't retreat.

Sigh, if only I could get the World Tree's Information Form Warning Network. This thing is practically a black technology to prevent the territory from being infiltrated. "

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly.

Compared to the World Tree, the territory of the three Universal Civilizations was like a sieve. Other people could enter and leave as they wished. They could even leave something inside, and the three Universal Civilizations would not be able to discover it in a short time. It was simply the standard configuration for victims.

He stroked his chin and pondered.

The goal of the World Tree and the third party was to cause internal strife in the galactic society, so the most important thing now was to not let the enemy's plan succeed. Since the spies could not be found in a short period of time, and the three Universal Civilizations' suspicions could not be dispelled, it seemed like he could only start from the suspects.

"It seems like the three Universal Civilizations are most suspicious of the Supercluster Alliance, and they happen to have other plans behind the scenes. However, I haven't found out what's going on yet … If this causes a misunderstanding between the two sides, I'm afraid we'll be in deep trouble."

Han Xiao was helpless.

In the past, he had always tricked the Supercluster Alliance, and it was not the first time they had "fallen from the sky". However, it was the opposite now. He had to think of a way to reduce their suspicions so that they would not become scapegoats …

Indeed, they had to pay for what they did!
